title: Planet health
summary: How well you are treating this world (🌍). A Biosphere Report sends it home every sol.
text:
**Planet health** (🌍 in the top bar, out of 100) is how well the colony is treating the world it landed on. At the end of every sol, a **Biosphere Report** sends the number home.

What lowers it:

- Strip-mined deposits and seams, burnt-out buildings and cleared nest sites scar the land
- Wiping out nests, or driving the inhabitants off their land, harms it for good

What raises it: a **Seed Bank** heals scarred land around it with spare biomass (never your food reserve), and with nothing left to heal it slowly rewilds. The research Low-Scar Extraction makes mining scar less.

You can't build a colony without leaving marks. How many you leave is up to you, and the planet is not the only one keeping count.
